## Easier gallery episode setup and production

A new `make_episode.py` in the integration episode starter drafts a py-shinywidgets gallery production from a gallery link, a gallery id, or explicit metadata. It reads a local clone's `app.py`, `requirements.txt`, and `index.md` front matter when present, detects renderers and a likely accessor, and writes a reviewable production with a checklist. A component docs, pull request, or commit link is kept as provenance but leaves the gallery, accessor, and hook as TODO; the script never guesses from those links or calls the network.

The episode capture starter now forwards `browser_args` from `capture.yaml`. Opt in with `--enable-unsafe-webgpu --use-angle=metal` for canvas widgets; preflight fails before recording if the adapter is missing or the widget reports a blank canvas. The recorder also warns about clips with more than seven seconds of footage between visible actions, so idle holds can be recut. A final result hold is not reported.

Code stills accept `code_wrap: smart` for long source lines. It removes the common indentation and wraps long lines at spaces with a short hanging indent, instead of wasting the card width on a deep original indent or splitting an identifier. An unbreakable line still fails the overflow check.

## Fixes

Burning captions with `--stop-at` now ends the last cue on the first word of a spoken closing line, so no caption appears over the end card. Bootstrap reports the variant recorded in a parent series lock and accepts `--variant` when the skill has moved between `.claude/skills/` and `.agents/skills/`, instead of failing with a generic incompatibility message.

Both skill variants ship the updated starter, scripts, and guides. New productions pin this release automatically; existing productions keep their current snapshot.
